description: "The Hoyden" by Mrs. Hungerford is a novel written in the late 19th century. The story revolves around the complexities of social status, marriage, and expectations within the British upper class, particularly focusing on the relationship dynamics among Lady Rylton, her son Maurice, and the vivacious heiress Tita Bolton.
